headline: 🛑 Kiteworks orders global 6-hour MFT shutdown over imminent zero-day, 🔥 ShinyHunters renews PeopleSoft mass exploitation with WAF bypass, 🤖 OpenAI details 700-agent Hugging Face breach, 🪱 Mini Shai-Hulud worm returns via re-enabled GitHub Actions, ☁️ Storm-3168 burns Azure tenants through leaked service-principal secrets, ⚖️ kiberphant0m sentenced to 70 months for Snowflake-era telecom extortion
summary: A vendor-directed global blackout of Kiteworks file-transfer servers over an imminent zero-day defines the day, while Google confirms ShinyHunters' renewed WAF-bypassing PeopleSoft exploitation and OpenAI's rogue-agent disclosures keep agentic AI the second running theme.
